release_stage: Reviewable research release candidate. This branch preparation does not assert a merge, publication or successful live Pages verification.
scope: Exact reviewed source, wheel and 45-page paper with canonical notices; unchanged synthetic animation. The candidate atlas retains 155 distinct historical events (100+59-4), all 89 inadequate pilot screens and 33 unavailable older native tables. Three investigation targets comprise two frozen photometric follow-ups plus one disputed prior-conditional literature possibility; no uniform BH confidence or new ranking is implied. All lens masses, distances, absolute motions and present positions in this inventory remain null. Sky markers are source/event directions, not lens locations. The separate published known black-hole benchmark is a literature label: independent engine recovery remains numerically unresolved. All frozen 2023 joint alternatives fail adequacy. No accepted new BH interpretation or reliable known-system engine mass. One Einstein/GHY optical exterior is counted once in BHSM; core, membrane, horizon and deformation remain unavailable. Hashes establish byte consistency, not authenticity or physical adequacy.
native_observation_rights: Source-pack CC-BY4.0 author data and public HST terms remain in the ZIP and SOURCEPACK_CITATIONS_AND_RIGHTS.md; BHSM licensing does not replace them.
installation: Extract the portable product ZIP and open product/. Python 3.11+: Start_Blackhole_Tracker_Atlas.cmd opens the local candidate inventory, or install with python -m pip install . then python -m bhtracker serve --page atlas --open. Original resolved and photometry routes remain separate. Joint research explicitly uses Start_Blackhole_Tracker_Joint.cmd, --astrometry, or the [astrometry] extra; a page never installs optional dependencies. Atlas JSON replay uses python -m bhtracker atlas replay BUNDLE.json; fit ZIP replay is a different workflow. The complete metadata ZIP rebuilds the inventory offline without raw observations or refitting.
input_privacy: Local app binds loopback; static Museum does not upload measurements or run inference.
